hook.name: NFTXFlexHook
hook.description: NFTXFlexHook lets any ERC-20 pair against an NFTX v4 collection token in its own pool, beside the canonical flETH pool. Pool creation is permissionless: dynamic fee, tick spacing 10/60/200, exactly one side an NFTX CollectionToken, pair token checked against an owner-updatable whitelist. Shares the canonical hook's swap, fee and oracle logic (dynamic LP fee, fixed AMM fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta). Swaps are open; the owner can retire a sunset collection's pool. CREATE3, same address per chain.
